description: Shared resolution sub-workflow: fetches Zendesk ticket, gates on betterstack-resolved tag, formats downtime comment, and updates ticket to solved with resolution comment + tags.

parameters.updateFieldsJson: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: "solved", type: "incident", tags: $json.newTags, comment: { body: $json.comment, public: true }, custom_fields: [ { id: 360048770292, value: "network" } ] }) }}

parameters.content:
## Betterstack Resolve Sub-workflow

**Purpose**: Shared resolution logic for Betterstack incidents. Called by:
- `betterstack-zendesk-receiver` (real-time webhook receiver)
- `betterstack-zendesk-poller` (5-min reconciler fallback)

**Inputs** (Execute Workflow Trigger):
- `zendesk_ticket_id` (string) — the Zendesk ticket to resolve
- `incident_id` (string) — the Betterstack incident ID (for the comment)
- `incident` (object) — the full Betterstack `data.attributes` payload
  (must contain `name`, `cause`, `started_at`, `resolved_at`)

**Idempotency**: First node fetches the ticket and the IF gate checks
for the `betterstack-resolved` tag. If present → no-op. If absent → run
the resolve flow and the Zendesk update appends `betterstack-resolved`
to the tags as the sentinel. This makes webhook retries and webhook/poller
races safe.

**Tag mutations** (computed in the Code node, applied as a full replacement):
- removes `betterstack-open`
- adds `betterstack-resolved`
- preserves all other existing tags

**Closed-ticket edge case**: If a ticket is already in `closed` state,
the Zendesk update API will reject status changes (Zendesk auto-closes
`solved` tickets after 24h, and `closed` is terminal). The receiver and
poller workflows are scoped to `status<closed`, so this should never
trigger here in practice — but documented for operators investigating
failures from the Update Zendesk Ticket node.

## Resolution Config (constants)

Set at the top of `resolve-subworkflow.workflow.ts`:

- `CATEGORY_FIELD_ID = 360048770292` — Zendesk Category custom field ID
- `CATEGORY_VALUE = "network"` — Category tag (display: "Network")
- `TICKET_TYPE = "incident"` — Zendesk SYSTEM `type` field (NOT custom);
  set at the top level of the update body. Valid: question | incident |
  problem | task. Required by Zendesk when transitioning to `solved`.
- `COMMENT_PUBLIC = true` — matches Zapier zap. Flip to `false` if the
  resolution comment should be an internal note.

After editing, re-validate and `mcp__n8n-mcp__update_workflow` to redeploy.
